verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms DGX B200 is marketed for LLM/inference workloads with strong inference performance claims (docs-1, docs-16, docs-19), but the pack contains no explicit documentation of FP8/FP4 precision support or named serving-stack integrations (TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, llama.cpp). Missing for 10: FP8/FP4 precision documentation, TensorRT-LLM/vLLM/llama.cpp support details, independent benchmarks confirming these stacks run on B200.
